style_axes.control_goal: quiet surface, restrained palette, clear focal anchor, high whitespace
strong grid, reading path, modular hierarchy, print-like order
geometric alignment, sans typography, strict spacing, neutral contrast
inspectable product, clean lighting, controlled reflections, credible material
soft light, warm neutrals, delicate material, low-noise atmosphere
precise geometry, luminous accents, dark-light contrast, no random sci-fi clutter
cultural symbols translated into modern structure without literal ornament overload
clear analysis logic, plan fidelity, spatial hierarchy, board-level readability
locked units, scale, north, axes, wall topology, openings, columns, dimensions, title block, and semantic layers before any visual styling
editable text, layer-controlled lineweights, explicit openings, door/window symbols, dimensions, elevations, material notes, detail indexes, and standard drawing order
expressive letterform, exact text, legible hierarchy, controlled distortion
label accuracy, diagram clarity, visual grouping, thin-line discipline
research proposition first, one dominant visual anchor, named evidence modules, maps/timelines/charts/process diagrams, application proof, and strict separation from commercial advertising
dark ritual field, luminous hierarchy, radial wheel or calendar anchor, taxonomy cards, pattern/source references, and no loose traditional ornament stacking
isometric process scene, numbered steps, technical callouts, material or plant analysis, clean blue-green palette, and readable educational sequencing
preserve skin texture, facial anatomy, catchlights, natural color, and believable local corrections
controlled highlight, readable edge contour, clean background, credible material and reflection
balanced crop, perspective correction, subject breathing room, leading lines, and strong focal hierarchy
coherent costume, hair, makeup, prop, architecture or landscape scene, soft cultural atmosphere, and respectful styling
